Shortcuts-app listing copy — what translates differently

Automation-forward listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Shortcuts app workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

  • 快捷指令 vs 捷径 — 快捷指令 is the standard App Store term for the Shortcuts app in mainland China; 捷径 is legacy vocabulary some buyers still search — see Simplified Chinese keywords guide for field packing
  • 自动化 vs 个人自动化 — 自动化 for general automation marketing; 个人自动化 when screenshots show the Personal Automation tab and trigger setup sheets
  • 文件夹 — folder organization when your gallery shows categorized shortcut collections
  • 共享表单快捷指令 — natural framing for Share Sheet shortcut rows in description and screenshot captions
  • Feature-accurate claims — if you market three gallery shortcuts and two personal automations, zh-Hans copy should name those workflows — not promise automation for features without Shortcuts integration
  • Natural automation Chinese — zh-Hans trigger descriptions buyers recognize, not 翻译腔 calques of English automation marketing

What good zh-Hans Shortcuts-app listing copy looks like

Listing fields should name the Shortcuts app workflows you actually ship — aligned with your screenshot order:

  • Subtitle — one concrete promise: “支持快捷指令与自动化” or “一键添加快捷指令” — not vague “提升效率” or a full English shortcut title
  • Keywords — mix category terms (待办, 记账, 健身) with Shortcuts intent (快捷指令, 自动化, 个人自动化, 捷径) within Connect’s ~100-character zh-Hans budget
  • Description — short paragraphs listing zh-Hans gallery and automation examples: “从快捷指令库一键添加，支持个人自动化触发” — mirror screenshot sequence
  • Screenshot captions on gallery frames — name the on-screen workflow: “快捷指令库一键添加” not “强大功能”
  • Automation trigger captions — when frames show Personal Automation setup, caption the trigger type: “到达办公室自动运行” not “Smart automation”
  • Folder organization captions — when gallery shows categorized shortcuts: “按场景分类的快捷指令文件夹”
  • Voice consistency — same 你/您 choice as your description across overlay lines and promotional text

  9. Verify China in Pricing and Availability — storefront enabled before expecting zh-Hans to appear
